user.title: Add Transit Stop
user.description: Enter the Timing Point Code (Haltenummer) shown on your Dutch public transit stop sign (bus, tram, metro, ferry, or regional train).

data_description.stop_code: 7 or 8-digit stop code, e.g. 30005029 for Amsterdam, Centraal Station.
data_description.line_number: Leave empty to track all lines, or enter specific line(s) separated by commas (e.g. 26 or 7, 39).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the OVapi server. Please verify your internet connection.
error.stop_not_found: The Timing Point Code was not found. Please verify your stop code.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check logs and try again.

abort.already_configured: This stop and line selection is already configured.
